name: Coordinator tools
responsibility: The coordinator's tool calls: each becomes one of the four operations of the workhorse of the checkout the call names, or, for stop_workhorses, a stop of every workhorse of the tab
description: Each workhorse tool takes a required checkout, the directory that holds a board's vault, and the replay ledger counts the same arguments in another checkout as another call. A delegation to a checkout whose workhorse has no thread that can run turns starts it first; the other three tools refuse a checkout with no ready workhorse and say so. stop_workhorses names no checkout and no turn: it interrupts the running turn of every workhorse of the tab session, and says what each one did.

outgoing.label: of the named checkout; a delegation starts it first
stop_workhorses: stop every running workhorse of the tab
